title: Festival Favorites at EPCOT | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Grab-N-Goof Located in World Celebration at EPCOT Stop by this casual eatery to explore an ever-changing menu filled with popular dishes from various EPCOT festivals.View Menu American Festival Kiosk Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type.Meal PricingRange reflects the average price of adult dinner entrées (breakfast and lunch generally cost less), except Character Dining locations, buffet locations, dinner shows, and special dining events where range reflects the average adult price of entire meal and non-alcoholic beverages. Range excludes alcoholic beverages, taxes and gratuities except at dinner shows where beer and wine, taxes and gratuities are included. Snack Menu – $ ($14.99 and under per adult) Festival FeastSavor delicious cuisine all year long. Festival Favorites at CommuniCore Hall is home to a different dining location each festival. Visit these vibrant spots for expertly prepared dishes designed to celebrate the spirit of the season.Festival Favorites – EPCOT International Food & Wine FestivalDiscover mouthwatering morsels along with specialty sips like alcoholic and nonalcoholic milkshakes.Favorites of Festivals Past – EPCOT International Festival of the HolidaysReminisce over beloved dishes—like Reuben croquettes and a decadent holiday trifle.Opening Bites – EPCOT International Festival of the ArtsStart your day with savory snacks or a luscious chocolate treat.Florida Fresh – EPCOT International Flower & Garden FestivalNourish yourself with flavorful fare made with healthy ingredients fresh from the garden.Meal Pricing
